A [[Quian (people)|Quian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to the Quian [[Karin Orlan]]. They were the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Benald Orlan]], who also had several younger siblings. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Benald's [[Gender/Legends|father]] was an Alliance sympathizer. Eventually, Benald sold out his family to the Empire, and, as a result, his father was [[Death/Legends|executed]].<ref name="Journal4">{{JournalCite|4|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
